package.intro1: Every great Italian journey begins with an idea - a city, a coastline, a feeling. Our curated packages are a starting point, not a script.
package.intro2: Choose one that speaks to you, then let us shape it around your pace, your tastes, and the Italy you've always imagined.
package.notQuiteRightBody: These packages are an invitation, not a brochure. Tell us your ideal length, the regions you're drawn to, and how you like to travel - we'll build something completely around you. One call is all it takes.

experience.intro1: Every great Italian stay is made up of smaller, perfect things — a market at dawn, a chef at your table, a boat with nowhere to be.
experience.intro2: These are the individual experiences we layer into your package to craft something that feels entirely, unmistakably yours.

curated.title: Carefully Curated & Managed Homes
curated.description: We handpick every home - from preparation to ongoing quality control, we ensure every property meets the standards of the Skylife Collection - so your stay feels effortless from the moment you arrive.

arrival.title: Easy Arrival & Living
arrival.description: Everything is arranged before you land. Private transfers, smooth check-in, and a home fully prepared for your stay — no friction, no waiting, no uncertainty.

designed.title: An Experience Designed Around You
designed.description: Away from the generic flows, we don't offer just any activity - we design your time in Italy around what matters to you. From private guides to boat days and hidden local gems, every moment is intentional.

connected.title: Always Connected, Always Supported
connected.description: From the moment you book until the end of your stay, we are personally available, responsive, and ready to assist — whether it's a reservation, a change of plan, or something unexpected.

poRules.intro: Whether it is a historic villa in Tuscany or a modern loft in Milan, Skylife manages Italian homes for owners who want more from their property, with exactly as much involvement as suits you.

full.title: Full Management
full.tagline: We handle everything — from first click to final goodbye.
full.intro: Designed for owners who want complete peace of mind. Skylife manages both the digital operation and the physical running of your property, so you can simply enjoy owning a home in Italy.
